confirmed: Available evidence has been reviewed and supports a confirmed incident assessment. Further details will be released through approved channels.
likely: Available information indicates the reported incident is likely, but some details remain under review. Further verification is ongoing.
possible: Initial information suggests a possible incident, but key details remain under verification.
unverified: We are aware of circulating reports and are reviewing available information. The available media has not yet been authenticated.
disputed: Available accounts conflict, and no final assessment has been made.
manipulated_unclear: Circulating media has not been authenticated and should not be treated as verified. We are reviewing source integrity and context.
humanitarian_unverified: We are aware of urgent humanitarian claims and are working to verify them while prioritizing civilian protection and safety.
translation_uncertain: Some circulated translations remain under review. Public conclusions should not rely on unverified translations alone.
